# Unity

[Unity](https://github.com/ThrowTheSwitch/Unity) v2.6.1 (tag commit `cbcd08fa7de711053a3deec6339ee89cad5d2697`), the C unit test framework the core's host tests use. MIT licensed, copyright (c) 2007-25 Mike Karlesky, Mark VanderVoord and Greg Williams; see `LICENSE.txt`.

The files are unchanged copies of `src/unity.c`, `src/unity.h` and `src/unity_internals.h`. They keep their own style: the core's warning flags, formatting and prose rules do not apply here. To update, copy the same files from a newer tag and change the version above in the same commit.
